handoff.purpose: finalize stale feature packaging, build the document, and provide serialization/load/refresh helpers

symbols.name: build
symbols.note: Derives the whole document; writes nothing. Accepts optional reports; calls analyse_once if not supplied. Builds entry points, env switches, module census, areas, stale features, counts, and digest.

symbols.name: inventory_bytes
symbols.note: Serializes the document dict to JSON with indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, and a trailing newline.

symbols.name: load
symbols.note: Reads a JSON file; returns None if missing, a dict on success, or {'__error__': str} on OSError/ValueError.

symbols.name: write_inventory
symbols.note: Serializes the doc, creates parent directories, writes the file with UTF-8 and newline='\n', and returns the text.

symbols.name: refresh
symbols.note: Regenerates the inventory in place, carrying annotations forward; reads old doc before overwriting and harvests annotations from schema-1 files.

observations.what: build returns a dict but its docstring says 'Derive the whole document' without mentioning the return type; the docstring is accurate about no writes.
load returns {'__error__': str} on OSError/ValueError but does not catch other exceptions like TypeError from malformed JSON; the error key is a string, not a nested error object.
write_inventory uses Path.write_text with newline='\n' and UTF-8, matching inventory_bytes' ensure_ascii=False; no atomic write or fsync is performed.
refresh calls harvest(old, modules, env_names) but the result is not used in this chunk; the function continues after the shown code.
The doc's 'unreached' count is computed as len(set(islands) | set(shims) | set(unknown)) and also stored as a list; the count is duplicated in the 'counts' dict and the list is in the top-level doc.
